description: Look up one Washington property from already-ingested county assessor records (King, Pierce, Snohomish, Whatcom counties). Returns cached property facts with field-level source observations and explicit unverified, missing, withheld and stale states: physical attributes, assessed values, last recorded sale, ownership tenure, and a coverage_note naming any fields the county extract lacks. Listing status, list price and days on market are populated only when the matched listing row came from a licensed listing provider (fields: listing_status, list_price, dom, listed_date, removed_date, listing_source, listing_status_source, listing_fetched_at, listing_attribution). When the only match is a scraped portal row, or no listing matched, all of them are null — which is the usual case today. Read a null as 'no licensed listing on file for this address', not as 'this home is not for sale', and do not infer a status or a price from the county fields. Owner identity fields (owner or taxpayer names, mailing addresses, owner-status classification) and equity estimates are not included in this version. Listing links, listing photos and portal automated valuations are not returned. Per-address queries only (RCW 42.56.070(8)); no area enumeration. Use a specific WA street address or county plus parcelId; a NOT_FOUND error means the address is outside covered counties or not in the ingested rows — say so rather than guessing. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.
